coverage: Exact unmodified supplemental runtime files, including source-format TeX/Lua/config/map files and original embedded license lines. These copies are NOT a complete upstream generated-source (.dtx/.ins), documentation or font-development archive. Compiled .tec files retain their shipped .map inputs. The basic package source subtree remains separately offered; file provenance is recorded in each group index.

texliveDistribution.status: Original full TeX Live distribution URL recorded by the pinned recipe; ISO bytes and its whole-archive hash are not available in this local source offer.

ubuntuSelectors.status: Historical Ubuntu Lunar file-list selector, not a pinned .deb or source archive; the exact distributed inputs are the release JS/data hashes above.

debianUbuntuSourceInputs.status: No exact .deb/.dsc/orig/debian source-input URLs or hashes are established by the pinned BusyTeX recipe or locally available payloads. They are not fabricated or claimed offered. A future source-completeness review must obtain and verify matching original inputs rather than assuming Ubuntu package naming proves byte provenance.
